description: A pyramid-like layout of playing cards is spread across the table, with a deck face down near the bottom center and a few loose cards off to the right. The right hand hovers near the right edge while the left hand moves down toward the deck, rests briefly on it as a left-hand object, then slides up and left to touch the left side of the card layout as if preparing to gather or deal cards, while the right hand stays mostly still without taking a card.
